summary: Mixed Martial Arts Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the public launch of the TrainAlta gear store in partnership with Zebra Athletics. The store sells combat-sports gear directly to the public, creating a new merchandise revenue channel alongside existing program revenues. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, capital return, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. This is a routine operational update. No deal terms are stated.
